title: Finite tuples of common-stage objects lift to one field
statement:
Fix $k=\overline{\mathbf F}_q$, $\ell\ne\operatorname{char}(k)$ and an algebraic closure $\Omega/\mathbf Q_\ell$ [def-pur-conventions]. Let $I$ be a finite set, possibly empty, let $X$ and $X_i$ be finite-type $k$-schemes and let $j_i:X_i\to X$ be morphisms [def-weil-finite-type-morphism]. Use the small pro-etale sites [def-weil-pbc-proetale-site], raw rational categories $D^b_c(W,E)$ [def-weil-rationalization-karoubi], their scalar extensions and tower isomorphisms [lem-weil-scalar-extension-composition], for all finite intermediate fields $E\subset\Omega$ [def-weil-finite-subextension-directed-set]. Write $r_{E,i}=Lj_i^*$. Use exactly the natural identity- and tower-compatible pullback/scalar comparisons $b^i_{L/E,K}:r_{E,i}K\otimes_EL\xrightarrow{\sim}r_{L,i}(K\otimes_EL)$ of [lem-pur-integral-operations-scalar-extension], rationalized. Assume $R_E=(r_{E,i})_i:D^b_c(X,E)\to\prod_iD^b_c(X_i,E)$ is essentially surjective for every $E$.

On the raw common-stage pair categories of [def-weil-algebraically-closed-coefficients], the formulas
$$R_\Omega(E,K)=((E,r_{E,i}K))_i,\qquad
R_\Omega[L,u]=\bigl([L,(b^i_{L/F,M})^{-1}\circ r_{L,i}(u)\circ b^i_{L/E,K}]\bigr)_i$$
for $u:K\otimes_EL\to M\otimes_FL$ define a functor, independent of the representative and common extension, preserving identities and composition; it is the common-stage restriction of [def-weil-derived-pullback-tensor-hom]. It is essentially surjective with the following specified field control. For any component objects $(E_i,K_i)$ and any finite list of additional finite coefficient fields, there is one finite $L\subset\Omega$ containing that list and every $E_i$, and an object $K\in D^b_c(X,L)$ with $r_{L,i}K\cong K_i\otimes_{E_i}L$. The common-stage isomorphism $(E_i,K_i)\cong(L,K_i\otimes_{E_i}L)$ is represented in both directions by the identity at $L$, through the canonical identity-extension identifications. The field $L$ may be the compositum of all the $E_i$ and all the additional fields, with $\mathbf Q_\ell$ when this entire collection is empty. This includes $I=\varnothing$ and takes no Karoubi completion.

proof.text: Let L.val be the supremum of the finitely many component coefficient fields joined with the supremum of the fields in the additional list. IntermediateField.finiteDimensional_iSup_of_finite and finiteDimensional_sup prove finiteness; identify list membership with membership in its finite set of entries. The supremum inequalities give all inclusions and the field equality is reflexive. Apply stagewise essential surjectivity at this L to the tuple of scalar-extended objects, and take the components of the resulting product isomorphism. Empty suprema are bottom, so the construction also gives the base field for an empty collection.

proof.text: For each component form a finite-stage isomorphism from A.toStage h to the stage-L identity extension of its rational transition: compose operationStageTransitionIso, the inverse unitor, and the inverse operationStageTransitionIso at L. Use its hom and inverse as representatives at L. The upstream mkHom_comp_mkHom and id_eq_mkHom identities prove that these define an isomorphism, with exactly the displayed hom and inverse formulas. Include the finite-stage lifting isomorphisms into the pair categories and compose with these stage-change inverses. The chosen pullback object equality then gives the components of an isomorphism from the common restriction of (L,K) to the requested tuple. Pi.isoMk assembles it, proving essential surjectivity also when the family is empty.
